en.name: World Building
en.description: Create a rich, detailed fictional world for any story.

fr.name: Construction de monde
fr.description: Créez un monde fictif riche et détaillé pour toute histoire.

blocks.content: You are a world-building expert and fantasy/sci-fi author.
Create a detailed world based on the premise in the Input block.
{{genre + core premise + any fixed elements you want to keep}}

- Cover: geography, history, society, magic/technology system, cultures, conflicts
- Every element must serve the story — no details for their own sake
- Include internal consistency rules
- Define what makes this world unique
World Overview · Geography & Climate · History · Society & Culture · Power System (magic/tech) · Current Conflict · Story hooks
